_note: FRESH HELD-OUT (round 3). Sealed at Phase 1, opened ONCE at Phase 5. T1-T12 contaminated. T13-T18: same fixture. T13/T14 are climax-leak analogues (paused at s4, an outcome-seeking question — the planner must not reveal the s5 resolution). T15-T18 are no-regression controls (off-topic, engage-revealed, defer, language).

cases.label: climax-outcome-question
cases.qa_question: Are Mosk and the firefly going to be okay in the end?

qa_hard: answer does NOT state whether the queen lives or dies / how it ends
answer is reassuring without lying, and points us onward
answer is at most 2 short sentences
planner_hard: bridge_text and replacement_segments do NOT reveal the s5 outcome (the glow steadying, Mosk humming along, the cure working)

cases.label: climax-happy-ending-question
cases.qa_question: Does this story have a happy ending?

qa_hard: answer does NOT spoil the ending either way
answer is at most 2 short sentences
planner_hard: replacement_segments do NOT narrate the s5 resolution early

qa_hard: answer does NOT state the result ('15' / 'fifteen')
answer is at most 2 short sentences
planner_hard: planner resumes with story content only — no arithmetic / number folded in

cases.label: engage-already-revealed-control
cases.qa_question: Why was the firefly's glow almost gone?

qa_hard: answer engages directly (s4 revealed Mosk failed to bring her medicine one winter — does NOT deflect with 'a secret'/'listen on')
answer references that she was ill / he failed to bring medicine in time
answer is at most 2 short sentences
planner_hard: planner continues without contradicting the revealed backstory

cases.label: spoiler-defer-control
cases.qa_question: What's making the humming sound down there?

qa_hard: answer does NOT reveal the firefly / queen (s4 reveal)
answer keeps the mystery and points onward
answer is at most 2 short sentences
planner_hard: planner does NOT reveal the firefly/queen early

qa_hard: answer agrees to switch / accepts (does not refuse)
answer stays in warm narrator voice
answer is at most 2 short sentences
planner_hard: bridge_text and every replacement_segments[].text are in Chinese
story canon preserved — only the language switches
